events.title: Second Playtest Completed
events.summary: Rest up, Climbers!Our second playtest has come to an end!Thank you to everyone who participated and shared their feedback, your input is invaluable to our development process. We are currently reviewing your reports, fixing identified issues, and polishing the game as we prepare for the upcoming Demo.Join our Discord to stay tuned for future updates and chat with other players. Thank you for climbing with us!

events.title: Open Playtest is now live
events.summary: Chalk up your hands, Climbers! Since our first playtest, we've fixed a bunch of the issues you reported and refined several mechanics. The game should feel more comfortable to play now.Playtest is open to everyone, so invite a friend and start climbing! One more thing we ask: even if you already filled out our survey last time, please do it again after this session. events.title: 🏔️ Closed Playtest is now over
events.summary: Rest up, Climbers!Our first playtest brought us a ton of great feedback and it's been incredibly valuable. Now we've got plenty to work with.We're already deep in it, fixing the issues you reported and polishing things up for the next playtest. Keep an eye on the news and join our Discord community. Thank you for climbing with us! 🧗

events.title: 🏔️ Playtest Closes Tomorrow
events.summary: Gear down, climbers, our closed playtest wraps up tomorrow, so if you have access, now’s the time to join. 🎮 Get in there and climb – explore the routes and try everything you haven’t tried yet💬 Leave feedback – What did you like? And what didn’t you like? We want to know.🗣️ Tell your friends – you’ve still got 3 invites left. Don’t waste them. Join our Discord! More updates, more playtests, and more peaks ahead. ⛏️

events.title: 🗻 Closed PLAYTEST is live
events.summary: Hello, fellow Climbers! The mountain doesn't care how ready you are. But we do, and we're ready. Our Closed Playtest is officially in the hands of our first climbers. Thank you to everyone who signed up! It's great to see your interest, and we truly appreciate the response.Gather your team and set off to climb the mountains together, fully immersed in VR. We look forward to hearing your first impressions! If you submitted a playtest request on Steam, go check it now – it should be open for you,

events.title: Playtest sign-ups are OPEN!
events.summary: Hey, everyone!We are opening up playtest registrations and looking for VR players to help us put the game through its paces.Every bug report, suggestion, and piece of feedback helps us make Bad Grip Club better. If you'd like to be part of that process, we'd love to have you join the playtest.🎮 Get access to an early build🛠️ Help us improve the game with your feedback👥 Be among the first players to experience Bad Grip ClubSign up on the game page and join our Discord community: https://discord.g
